#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

pod=$(kubectl get pods -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase --no-headers \
  | fzf --prompt="pod> " | awk '{print $1}')
[ -z "$pod" ] && exit 0

containers=$(kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].name}')
if [ "$(echo $containers | wc -w)" -gt 1 ]; then
  container=$(echo $containers | tr ' ' '\n' | fzf --prompt="container> ")
  kubectl exec -it "$pod" -c "$container" -- sh -c 'bash || sh'
else
  kubectl exec -it "$pod" -- sh -c 'bash || sh'
fi
summary_zh: fzf 選 pod 與 container 後 exec shell
